refusal.invariant: Generated outputs descend from a current human-backed summary confirmation.
refusal.userMessage: Cannot start review for "nfr-design": its question flow has no nfr-design-questions.md file. Create and answer the stage questions, then record the consolidated summary checkpoint before generating artifacts.

remedies.action: Request the next permitted review for the current attempt: run `aidlc engine log review --stage nfr-design --reviewer aidlc-architecture-reviewer-agent --unit u1-astronomy --iteration 1 --project-dir /Users/glen/Documents/stargazer`, then dispatch the reviewer named in it as a subagent and have it write the `reviewFile` that command returns: that file is the reviewer's, so never write it yourself and never stand in for it (`.kiro/aidlc-common/protocols/stage-protocol-reviewer.md` step 1 says what to pass it). When its verdict is back, record it with the `recordVerdict` command the request returns.

remedies.label: Confirm the summary again
remedies.description: I'll show you the current summary of your answers for NFR Design for u1-astronomy to confirm, then save its documents again from it.
remedies.action: Present the current consolidated summary and record it with the checkpoint flags (a plain decision or answer never counts): `aidlc engine log decision --checkpoint summary-confirmation --stage nfr-design --unit u1-astronomy --questions-file '<path to nfr-design-questions.md>' --decision 'Does this all look correct?' --options 'Looks correct,Request changes'`, with exactly one blank `[Answer]:` line in the summary section; end the turn; after the human's fresh reply run `aidlc engine log answer --checkpoint summary-confirmation --stage nfr-design --unit u1-astronomy --questions-file '<path to nfr-design-questions.md>' --details 'Looks correct'`. Then regenerate or re-save the produced artifacts.

Redo "nfr-design" for unit "u1-astronomy" only: continue with /aidlc and do that step again for unit "u1-astronomy". The other units keep their finished work, reviews, Plan Approvals and checkpoint approvals.
